## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
CAUTION. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. VXX (1W: -4.38% | 1M: -5.84%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling and broad sector strength argue for risk appetite, while the HYG/LQD signal flagged as CREDIT STRESS ↓ (credit stress rising) provides a conflicting risk cue.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Fear DECREASING: VXX (1W: -4.38% | 1M: -5.84%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling. Credit signal DETERIORATING: HYG/LQD flagged CREDIT STRESS ↓ (HYG (1W: +0.65% | 1M: +0.31%) ABOVE TREND; LQD (1W: +0.72% | 1M: -0.65%) RECOVERY). Gold strength also supporting risk hedge: GLD (1W: +7.25% | 1M: +5.37%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral-to-supportive overall: UUP proxy (Dollar) (1W: -0.35% | 1M: -1.13%) BELOW TREND → flat; TLT (1W: +1.03% | 1M: -1.65%) RECOVERY ↑ rising; SPY (1W: +3.51% | 1M: +2.87%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Tech leading: XLK (1W: +7.20% | 1M: +1.41%) ABOVE TREND. Financials showing strength via breadth (XLF proxy: 1W: +1.48% | 1M: +4.91%) ABOVE TREND. Defensives lagging: XLU (1W: -1.67% | 1M: -3.37%) BELOW TREND; XLE in CORRECTION (1W: -3.44% | 1M: +4.89%) — Style: Growth/Momentum leading.

5. US vs Global?
US outperforming: SPY (1W: +3.51% | 1M: +2.87%) ABOVE TREND. EM mixed: EEM (1W: +2.42% | 1M: -1.71%) RECOVERY; China nuanced: FXI (1W: -0.90% | 1M: +8.26%) CORRECTION — watch regional dispersion.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculation recovering: ARKK (1W: +11.50% | 1M: -2.58%) RECOVERY and IBIT (1W: +3.25% | 1M: +2.76%) ABOVE TREND. Small caps running: IWM (1W: +3.56% | 1M: +1.45%) ABOVE TREND.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Precious metals strong: GLD (1W: +7.25% | 1M: +5.37%) ABOVE TREND and SLV (1W: +9.82% | 1M: +6.21%) ABOVE TREND. Industrial metals holding up: CPER (1W: +0.86% | 1M: +5.70%) ABOVE TREND.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy mixed/patchy: XLE (1W: -3.44% | 1M: +4.89%) CORRECTION and BNO (1W: -6.85% | 1M: +11.29%) CORRECTION; natural gas weak: UNG (1W: -3.18% | 1M: -10.06%) BELOW TREND.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
CONFIRMED: Broad equity lift — SPY (1W: +3.51% | 1M: +2.87%) ABOVE TREND and XLK (1W: +7.20% | 1M: +1.41%) ABOVE TREND. DIVERGENCE: QQQ (1W: +5.09% | 1M: -0.03%) RECOVERY and TLT (1W: +1.03% | 1M: -1.65%) RECOVERY show 1W/1M mismatches that warrant caution.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor exposure to areas showing strength (XLK (1W: +7.20% | 1M: +1.41%) ABOVE TREND and financials via XLF proxy (1W: +1.48% | 1M: +4.91%) ABOVE TREND) while reducing exposure to duration and commodity-dislocated energy (UNG (1W: -3.18% | 1M: -10.06%) BELOW TREND, XLE CORRECTION).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: XLK (if 1M stays positive) — XLK (1W: +7.20% | 1M: +1.41%) ABOVE TREND; Materials / Industrials (XME/XLI proxies) as cyclical participation continues (XME (1W: +14.99% | 1M: +12.11%) ABOVE TREND). BEARISH: XLE (1W: -3.44% | 1M: +4.89%) CORRECTION and XLU (1W: -1.67% | 1M: -3.37%) BELOW TREND if rate sensitivity reasserts.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: Precious metals GLD (1W: +7.25% | 1M: +5.37%) ABOVE TREND and SLV (1W: +9.82% | 1M: +6.21%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Natural gas UNG (1W: -3.18% | 1M: -10.06%) BELOW TREND and oil proxies with 1W weakness vs 1M gains (BNO (1W: -6.85% | 1M: +11.29%) CORRECTION).

13. Key Levels?
VXX 20 (complacency threshold) — VXX (1W: -4.38% | 1M: -5.84%) BELOW TREND. HYG/LQD ~0.75 (credit health) — Credit Spread Level 0.7472 (1W: -0.04% | 1M: +0.78%) CORRECTION. Tech vs Financials pivot ~3.26 — Tech vs Financials Level 3.2634 (1W: +5.17% | 1M: -2.14%) RECOVERY. Copper/Gold CPER/GLD ~0.1001 (↓ falling).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive, but conflicting signals (VXX ↓ falling and HYG/LQD flagged CREDIT STRESS ↓) warrant a cautious tilt. XLK (1W: +7.20% | 1M: +1.41%) and financials (XLF proxy 1W: +1.48% | 1M: +4.91%) showing strength while QQQ (1W: +5.09% | 1M: -0.03%) and TLT (1W: +1.03% | 1M: -1.65%) divergences are the key risks to monitor.
